'''R8-X4F''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] at the start of the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Invasion of Ossus]], it went rogue and was brought down by Imperial or Republic forces.<ref name="CW" />
